rationale: Final release of the run's local work. The investigation is complete as far as its authorization allows and its two decisive capacities are exhausted: audit units (no new obligation can be opened) and semantic reviews (the end-to-end client-reply artifact, executed as 6baf5b7715294d88a8f4a36e085ebd04, cannot be reviewed; the reader-side observation from exploration 5b9267ea51d742f9a6fdcfb7a6594990 cannot be fixed as a claim with its own artifact). Everything else has been recorded at its proper coordinate: twelve claim families with executed artifacts, a map current at version 20, complete source coverage of the analysis roots, and the residual items named rather than implied. The remaining observations are either deployment premises (whether the latency file, durable recording or transitive-skip flag are enabled) or scoped questions with pause conditions (accept-status semantics, client retry) or the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact, for which the framework offers no accepted mechanism.
resume_conditions: semantic review capacity, to confirm the executed end-to-end client-reply artifact
audit unit capacity, to fix the exploration-derived reader-side observation as a claim with an artifact that observes the exit through a controlled expectation
